name: Pack a picnic
description: Bring sandwiches and a blanket to your favorite park.
tip: Leave your phones in your bag for the first ten minutes.

name: Pasta night for two
description: Cook a simple pasta dinner together.
tip: One person cooks, the other picks the playlist.

name: Taco stop
description: Share a casual meal at a local taco spot.
tip: Each pick a taco for the other to try.

name: Split a pizza
description: Pick a neighborhood pizza place and share a pie.
tip: Debate your most controversial pizza topping.

name: Pantry challenge
description: Make dinner using ingredients you already have.
tip: Each pick one ingredient. Make something together.

name: Backyard cookout
description: Grill a simple dinner outside.
tip: Set the table outside, even if it is just a blanket.

name: Golden-hour walk
description: Explore a park or a new neighborhood together.

name: Board game showdown
description: Choose a game you already own and keep score.
tip: Winner gets to choose the final entertainment.

name: Museum afternoon
description: Visit a small museum; check admission before heading out.
tip: Find one piece that reminds you of each other.

name: Paint each other's portrait
description: Use basic art supplies and reveal your masterpieces.

name: Mini golf match
description: Play a friendly round of outdoor mini golf.

name: Photo scavenger hunt
description: Make a list of things to photograph on a walk.

name: Ice cream stroll
description: Grab a scoop each and enjoy it outside.

name: Bake brownies
description: Bake a small batch and share the first warm piece.

name: Something sweet from home
description: Share a snack you already have in the pantry.

name: Coffee and a pastry

name: Fresh fruit break

name: Hot chocolate for two

name: Stargazing
description: Find a safe spot away from bright lights and look up.

name: Movie night at home
description: Choose a film from a service or collection you already have.

name: Catch a matinee

name: Sunset watch

name: Make-your-own trivia
description: Write questions for each other and host a mini quiz.

name: Sushi date

name: Steakhouse evening
description: Dress up for a steakhouse dinner for two.

name: Chef’s tasting menu

name: Private chef at home

name: Omakase celebration
description: Plan a premium chef-led omakase experience.

name: Private chef celebration menu

name: Garden chef’s table

name: Kayak adventure

name: Bike trail cruise
description: Rent bikes and explore an easy scenic route.

name: Skating date

name: Botanical garden wander
description: Explore a botanical garden together.

name: Hot-air balloon outing

name: Guided horseback ride
description: Book a guided trail ride matched to your experience.

name: Private sailing afternoon
description: Arrange a private sailing outing with a skipper.

name: Scenic helicopter experience

tip: Confirm the route, duration, restrictions, and complete quote.

name: Private art workshop
description: Arrange a private guided art session for two.
tip: Create something inspired by your favorite memory.

name: DIY spa retreat
description: Set up a relaxed evening with simple spa supplies and music.

name: Patisserie tasting
description: Pick a selection of specialty pastries to share.

name: Artisan chocolate selection
description: Share a box of specialty chocolates.

name: Chef-made dessert experience
description: Arrange a special plated-dessert experience.

name: Bespoke celebration dessert

name: Comedy club night
description: See a live comedy show together.

name: Live jazz evening
description: Enjoy a seated live jazz performance.
tip: Listen for a song you would add to your playlist.

name: Theater night
description: Choose a live stage production for two.

name: Private cinema screening
description: Arrange a private screening where available.
